To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the endophytic fungi from the coniferous plants have the biosynthetic potentiality of Taxol and its analogs, and the genome mining and metabolic engineering of the endophytic Taxol producers can be the promising strategy to improve the productivity of Taxol.
the genome mining and metabolic manipulation of Taxol biosynthesis by fungal endophyts of Taxaceae and Podacarpaceae are the key factors for industrial production of Taxol.
the Taxol biosynthesis from endophytic fungi of conifer plant is a promising approach for industrial Taxol productions, but the productivity is a challenge.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the identification and exploitation of the endophytic fungi of coniferous plants with Taxol production potency and its molecular manipulation for the rapid screening of the Taxol biosynthesis machinery and the enhancement of Taxol productivity.
the exploitation of Taxol biosynthesizing fungal endophytes of conifers for the production of Taxol and its derivatives.
the exploitation of the biosynthetic potency of Taxol from the endophytic fungi of conifers plants; genome mining and metabolic manipulations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
endophytic fungi have a great potential to be a promising source of Taxol production, however, the metabolic manipulation of the fungal endophytes is the key for its industrial application.
the Taxol biosynthesis in endophytic fungi is an attractive and promising alternative for Taxol production.

endophytic fungal strains are potential source for Taxol production, and genome mining is an alternative approach for the rapid screening of rate limiting enzymes and transcription factors for Taxol production.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the genome mining of Taxol biosynthesis genes from endophytic fungal genomes and its expression analysis would be the key for rapid screening of the endophytic fungi with high Taxol productivity.
the Taxol biosynthesis is a complex process, involving a large number of genes and enzymes, which can be manipulated by the molecular approaches to increase the productivity of Taxol.
the Taxol producing endophytic fungi from the conifer plants are the promising source for industrial Taxol.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the genome mining of endophytic fungal strains for Taxol producing genes will provide a platform for the development of a rapid screening method for Taxol biosynthesis.
the endophytic fungi from the host plants are the most potent source of Taxol.
, the endophytic fungi from the conifer plants have been considered as the potential candidates for Taxol production with the genome mining approach and metabolic manipulation.
